notes.title: Fight the virus, stay at home SALE
notes.notes:
Due to the recent outbreaks of Covid-19 most of us have been urged to stay at home to prevent further spread of the virus. And because staying at home is more fun if you can play videogames, I decided to put ALL of my games on sale for 50% off.

Stay at home, stop the virus! And enjoy gaming while you save lives :)

notes.title: FAQ/Troubleshooting Guide
notes.notes: If you are having problems running the game, please refer to the FAQ/Troubleshooting guide in the community. If you encounter game specific issues or bugs, thank you for staying calm and taking the time to write down the issue there. I will do my best to fix any game related bugs I can. Due to the old nature of the engine I will not be able to fix engine related bugs, however. I apologize.
